God Gundam asks to be taken to the reservoir in Desert Cube to train. Take God Gundam there.
God Gundam and the others made it to the reservoir.
We're here, God Gundam. This is the reservoir.

Training in a place like this? What the hell are you planning to do?
What training needs is a quiet place.
Here, I should be able to focus my mind.
From here on, the enemy will only grow stronger.

Sorry, Ankh, but could you leave me alone for a little while?

Haaaah... Taaah!!

Why!? Why can't I remember the feeling I had back then!?

Are you telling me a mere reservoir like this is no place to train!?
Why!? Why are you here!?
What drivel are you spouting? I am a phantom born of your own heart!
Rugged mountains, forests, waterfalls... Must the stage be set for you!? You imbecile!
And thaaat is why you are such an utter fool!!
Shut up... Shut up, shut uuuuuup!!
Yes!! Rage!! Fill your heart with anger!
Damn you... Master Gundam!! Get out of my waaaaaay!!
Calm yourself, God Gundam!
What? Who's there!?

notes.note: Rows 226-286 continue the unreferenced second quest in the DG_QUEST018 table (exhibit-room key / rusty sword, Shocker Cube): Quest018.bla only plays the Money Dopant quest and no other script loads QuestEventMess018, so every speaker here is inferred from wording. 226-231 end the 15-row leader block 217-231 begun in quest_020 (same English).
232 and 248 single lines, speaker unknown (likely the leader); voiced neutral. 'Which room it opens' restores the object of the dropped verb.

233-247: 15-row leader block, order unknown. Pattern matches 217-231 (rough at index 5, polite at index 8): 238 is the rough variant and talks about the Gaia Memory room from memory (reads like Shotaro/W), 241 the polite 'desu ne' variant; all others identical.
Heartbeat/pulse sound (Bullton), no speaker; quoted as an SFX per glossary style. Same English at 269.

254-258 (5 rows, likely the Ultra leaders who recognise the kaiju) and 259-268 (10 rows, the others) look like one split leader choice. 'Bullton' and 'Fourth-Dimension Kaiju' per CharacterName/ChipLib translations. 261 is the rough variant; 'this thing' avoids gendering the kaiju (g=n).
Speaker unknown; singular 'it' because only Bullton appears.

Speaker unclear: an archaic imperative, probably God Gundam (Domon) recalling a teaching or reading an inscription on the case; rendered as a plain line without a name. 276/279/282 God Gundam (the sword was his request in quest_020).
278/280/281: the rough companion (leader or Ankh-type voice; 181 in quest_020 was the same rough voice). Insult kept at full strength. 'Rusty Sword' per ItemNameFormal 4.17.
'Janen' rendered 'evil thoughts' (the mental impurity a martial artist cuts away), not 'impure thoughts', to avoid an unwanted connotation.
Quest title has no QuestMess entry (cut quest); 'treasure vault' follows QuestMess 0.64's rendering.
Quest-board description. Source says 'G Gundam' (series name) for God Gundam; written as God Gundam to match QuestMess 0.70 and the event.

Quest019.bla plays row TextIdOffset+N+1 (calibrated: +3 narration = 4, +5 God Gundam = 6, +6 Ankh = 7, +7/+8 = 8/9, +10/+11 = 11/12, row 10 empty; +23 '???' = 24, +24 Master Gundam = 25, +33 '???' = 34, +34 God = 35). Rows 5, 13, 14, 29 are not referenced by the script; speakers from content (5/14 Ankh, 13 God Gundam, 29 Master Gundam).

Name box shows '???' (Master Gundam before it appears, CHARA_NAME 30); 'baka mono' rendered 'You fool' (not the glossary's 'stupid pupil' line, which is a different phrase). 27 'I am a phantom born of your own heart': the vision is Domon's own illusion.
34 '???': an unidentified warm voice calming God Gundam (continues in quest_022); kept neutral.

Bullton/'Fourth-Dimension Kaiju' from existing CharacterName/ChipLib English; quest title 'Treasure Vault Investigation' is new (cut quest).
